build_VideoMaskFormer_from_config: build a VideoMaskFormer model from a detectron2 config using the from_config class method
run_VideoMaskFormer_forward: run the VideoMaskFormer forward pass on batched video inputs for training or inference
test_VideoMaskFormer_inference_video: test the inference_video method to get top-10 predicted masks with scores and labels
review_VideoMaskFormer_prepare_targets: review the prepare_targets method that assembles ground truth masks and labels across video frames
refactor_VideoMaskFormer_criterion_weigh: refactor the VideoMaskFormer loss weight dictionary to add or remove deep supervision auxiliary losses
